assumptions: Binary (IEC) rate convention with the published prefix ladder extended: pebi- = 2^50 bytes per unit (same ladder as the b10 pebibit record).
Sustained average rate over the same averaging interval for input and output.

constants.locator: Binary prefixes ladder: pebi- is the 2^50 step (b10 translation notes verify 2^50 = 1125899906842624 by exact integer arithmetic).
constants.meaning: binary bytes per second per pebibyte per second

gaps: Meanings pebibyte_rate/byte_rate and unit PiB/s absent from runtime vocabulary; scalar form fits engine once meanings exist.
Shares the 2^50 factor with the b10 pebibit-to-bit record; units differ (bytes vs bits) - no overlap.

models.inverse_notes: R_PiBps = R_Bps/1125899906842624 needs R_Bps. Check: 2251799813685248 gives 2. Negative R_Bps rejected via mapped guard. Algebraic only.
limitations: Value derived from the published prefix ladder, not a tabulated per-unit row; verified 2^50 in b10 translation notes.
Asserted rate only; excludes overhead.

references.method: Prefix-ladder derivation: pebi- is the 2^50 IEC binary step; exact integer.
references.provenance: Independent derivation from published prefix ladder (Data-rate units binary prefixes; b10 verification).

references.method: Ordinary case 2 x 2^50, different scale from the unit row.
references.provenance: Independent arithmetic check with synthetic inputs.

references.method: Boundary: zero asserted rate converts to zero; admitted ideal boundary.
references.provenance: Independent limiting identity.

rejection_cases.reason: Negative asserted rate violates R_PiBps >= 0.
Rate R_PiBps is required; empty input leaves R_Bps undetermined.

relationship.locator: Binary prefixes (IEC 80000-13) section: pebi- denotes 2^50 (b10 pebibit record verifies the integer).
relationship.translation_notes: Expression is written in canonical base units: R_PiBps arrives already scaled by the PiB/s registry scale, so the projection is the identity and the 2^50 (1125899906842624) factor is carried by the PiB/s/B/s unit scales (documented in constants; dev ships the matching rate vocabulary at admission time), never inlined. Check: information/time preserved.
